content:
“Your digestive tract has adjusted to the weirdness of the Wasteland!”

**Lead Belly** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Decreased radiation from eating and drinking based on current Endurance.

| ![FO76 lead belly perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/d/d2/FO76_lead_belly_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Endurance | Radiation Reduction | 
| | 1 | 18% | 
| | 15 | 61% | 
| | 30 | 96% | 
| | 60 | 131% | 
| | 100 | 175% | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You take less radiation from eating or drinking based on your END. | 0004A0B9 | 

- Although radiation reduction can reach even 175% at 100 Endurance, the 100% limit is reached at 34 Endurance.
- A card is found in Vault 76 on checkpoint pop-up number 6, labeled "Get a Job."
- Before Update 58 Lead Belly had 3 ranks that reduced radiation from eating or drinking by 30%/60%/100%.

Card in Vault 76

Other perks that scale with Endurance include:

- Adamantium Skeleton - Less limb damage
- Iron Stomach - Bonus damage and energy resistance
- LifeGiver - Bonus HP
- Natural Resistance - Bonus elemental resistance
- Rad Resistant - Bonus radiation resistance
- Thirst Quencher - More AP
- Vaccinated - Higher disease resistance
